eps.t: Save the Porcupine! / Save the Runaway Egg!
eps.o: A porcupine gets stuck in a tight spot, and a mama chicken's precious egg rolls away.

eps.t: Save the Mountain Lion! / Save the Baby Chick!
eps.o: A mountain lion aims a little too high for his size, and a hungry chick struggles to be seen and heard.

eps.t: Save the Woodpecker! / Save the Salmon!
eps.o: A woodpecker can't shake free from a tree, and a young salmon needs some uplifting words to make it upstream.

eps.t: Save the Hedgehog! / Save the Hippo!
eps.o: A hedgehog becomes a "wedged-hog," and a hippo's cooldown turns into a muddy mess.

eps.t: Help the Peacock! / Save the Woolly Mammoth!
eps.o: A peacock questions his dancing abilities, and a woolly mammoth gets trapped on a chunk of ice.

eps.t: Save Tate? / Save the Song Birds!
eps.o: A search for a souvenir lands Tate inside a sidewalk grate, and two song birds need to find their rhythm.

eps.t: Help the Bear Cub! / Save the Sad Sumi-e Frog!
eps.o: A bear cub would rather play all day than go to bed, and a painted frog could use some cheering up.

eps.t: Save the Roly Poly! / Save Jack (and the Giant, Too)!
eps.o: A lonely pill bug looks for a pal, and Jack goes on the run from a much (much) bigger kid.

eps.t: Save the Elephant! / Help the Little Hawk!
eps.o: A thirsty elephant who's blind needs to find the watering hole, and a young hawk tries tackling an impressive move.

eps.t: Save the Screaming Goat! / Help the Wild Culpeo!
eps.o: A dwarf goat has a serious case of the yelps, and an energetic fox is eager to play with a delicate butterfly.

eps.t: Save the Chinchilla! / Help the Golden Spider?
eps.o: A chinchilla needs rescuing from a tricky spot, and a spider wants to spin a web that'll wow.

eps.t: Help the Caribbean Crab! / Save the Bighorn Sheep!
eps.o: A crab's colorful castle risks getting washed away, and two sibling sheep fight over who goes first.

eps.t: Help the Red Squirrel! / Help the Dung Beetle!
eps.o: A squirrel loses track of a buried treat, and a beetle battles a blowfly over a ball of dung.
